name: sort-nulls-placement
why: inverts NULLS FIRST/LAST in the executor's in-memory sort; changes row ORDER only, so a multiset-only assertion is blind to it

name: sort-direction
why: inverts ASC/DESC in the executor's in-memory sort; the broadest ordering defect available

name: is-null-inverted
why: IS NULL returns FALSE for NULL and TRUE otherwise; changes which rows QUALIFY, the broadest predicate defect

name: is-not-null-inverted
why: the IS NOT NULL twin of the above; a corpus can easily cover one spelling and not the other
